reviews.name: Roman Sulz
reviews.text: It's tucked between the beach and the mountains, which creates this really peaceful, relaxing vibe. It's away from the busy parts of Dahab, so it feels like a true escape.

reviews.name: Kimberly Shamey
reviews.text: The highlight was the delicious Egyptian breakfast in the morning and the private beach with a hammock.

reviews.name: Diana ElSayegh
reviews.text: The views are breathtaking, offering both a sea view and mountain views. If you're looking for a peaceful place to work away from the hustle, this is it.

reviews.name: Mohamed Elsholkami
reviews.text: I really enjoyed watching the sunrise and sunset while sitting in the cafe they have set up in front of the sea.

reviews.name: Azra Fakhruddin
reviews.text: Staff very polite and helpful and hospitable. Their cafe on the beach is great too!

reviews.name: Adam Hassan
reviews.text: Behind you is the mountains and the sea in front of you: 15 meters and you are on the beach.
